title: What a Waste 3.0
citation: Cook, Ed, Kremena Ionkova, Perinaz Bhada-Tata, Sonakshi Yadav, and Frank van Woerden. 2026. What a Waste 3.0: Global Snapshot of Solid Waste Management Toward Circularity until 2050. World Bank. Country and city datasets.

tonnes.label: Waste generated
tonnes.description: Municipal waste: households and similar waste from businesses and institutions. Measurement boundaries differ by place.

perPerson.label: Waste per person
perPerson.description: The source’s municipal waste quantity relative to population. It is an area average, not a household measurement.

treatment_open_dumpsite.label: Open dumping
treatment_open_dumpsite.description: Disposal with no or limited controls.

treatment_controlled_landfill.label: Controlled landfill
treatment_controlled_landfill.description: Land disposal with basic operational controls.

treatment_sanitary_landfill_landfill_gas.label: Sanitary landfill
treatment_sanitary_landfill_landfill_gas.description: Land disposal with improved or full controls under the source classification.

treatment_landfill_unspecified.label: Landfill · type unspecified
treatment_landfill_unspecified.description: The source does not establish the level of landfill control.

treatment_anaerobic_digestion.label: Anaerobic digestion
treatment_anaerobic_digestion.description: Biological treatment without oxygen, producing gas and a digestate.

treatment_recycling.label: Sent for recycling
treatment_recycling.description: The World Bank defines this as waste collected for recycling. It does not establish the quantity of usable material recovered after processing losses.

treatment_incineration.label: Incineration
treatment_incineration.description: Controlled thermal treatment, with or without energy recovery. Open burning is excluded.

treatment_mbt.label: Mechanical & biological treatment
treatment_mbt.description: Combined sorting and biological processing. This is a treatment stage rather than proof of a final recycled product.

treatment_rdf.label: Fuel preparation
treatment_rdf.description: Processing into refuse-derived fuel. Subsequent burning is a separate step.

treatment_other.label: Other treatment
treatment_other.description: Treatment not otherwise specified in the source.

treatment_unaccounted_for.label: Unaccounted for
treatment_unaccounted_for.description: A gap explicitly reported by the source; OVERSHOOT does not calculate or redistribute it.

uncollected.label: Uncollected
uncollected.description: Municipal waste outside the recorded collection system. Its destination is not inferred.

collection_households.label: Households with collection
collection_households.description: Collection coverage uses the stated denominator. Population, household and waste-weight percentages are different measures.

collection_population.label: Population with collection
collection_population.description: Collection coverage uses the stated denominator. Population, household and waste-weight percentages are different measures.

collection_waste.label: Waste collected
collection_waste.description: Collection coverage uses the stated denominator. Population, household and waste-weight percentages are different measures.

other_agricultural.label: Agricultural waste
other_agricultural.description: A separate non-municipal waste measure. It is not added to municipal waste or overlapping categories.

other_construction_and_demolition.label: Construction & demolition waste
other_construction_and_demolition.description: A separate non-municipal waste measure. It is not added to municipal waste or overlapping categories.

projection_2022.label: 2022 modeled waste
projection_2022.description: World Bank modeled municipal waste generation for this year. These are projections, not observed quantities. The 2022 estimate is the comparable baseline.

projection_2030.label: 2030 modeled waste
projection_2030.description: World Bank modeled municipal waste generation for this year. These are projections, not observed quantities. The 2022 estimate is the comparable baseline.

projection_2050.label: 2050 modeled waste
projection_2050.description: World Bank modeled municipal waste generation for this year. These are projections, not observed quantities. The 2022 estimate is the comparable baseline.

distance.label: Distance to main treatment or disposal facility
distance.description: Reported distance from city centre to the main land disposal or recovery facility. It is not a traced shipment or the distance traveled by all waste.
